newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates BDB A minus l-term, A2 s-term.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates BDB A minus l-term, A2 s-term.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Thursday it assigned Banco di Desio e della Brianza (BDB) a long-term rating of A minus and a short-term rating of A2.
At the same time, IBCA said it assigned BDB an individual rating of B/C and a legal rating of 5.

"BDB's profitability is strong and the health of the economy in the provinces in which the bank operates is reflected in its asset quality, which is considerably better than the average for Italian banks," IBCA said in a statement.
So far, it said, BDB had limited its expansion to the Lombardy region and, at end-1995, it ranked around 100th in Italy in terms of total assets.
"BDB is liquid and well capitalised, with an end-1995 total capital ratio of 16.10 percent," IBCA said.
